guard: cotal_spawn forwards an inline persona whole through a closed schema and audits its model like an override, and cotal_persona forwards capabilities
why: The suite imports MeshAgent and the tool specs by relative source path, so the bytes mutated are
the bytes graded; its core imports are values the mutations do not touch, or erased types.
C1 and C2 each drop the inline persona at one hop, the agent's spawn arguments and the tool's
handoff, so the manager would spawn a catalog persona by the helper's name. C3 opens the closed
schema, so a field the record has no slot for reaches the manager. C4 audits only the top-level
model, so an inline model the manager did not record passes as a launched pin. C5 and C6 each drop
cotal_persona's capabilities at one hop, so a definer's capabilities never reach the bound.
C7 trims the inline model for the audit while the record carries it as written, so a seat
that launched on the padded model the manager recorded is reported as a dropped pin.
NOT PROVED HERE: the manager's own refusal of an unknown record key, which its suite proves.

mutations.name: C1 drop the inline persona from the spawn arguments
mutations.expectRed: cotal_spawn tool forwards the inline persona whole, beside its first-turn prompt

mutations.name: C2 drop the inline persona from the tool's handoff
mutations.expectRed: cotal_spawn tool forwards the inline persona whole, beside its first-turn prompt

mutations.name: C3 open the inline persona schema
mutations.expectRed: the inline persona schema refuses a field it has no slot for

mutations.name: C4 audit only the top-level model
mutations.expectRed: an inline persona's model the manager did not record is refused like an override

mutations.name: C5 drop capabilities from the define-persona arguments
mutations.expectRed: cotal_persona forwards capabilities for the manager to bound

mutations.name: C6 drop capabilities from cotal_persona's handoff
mutations.expectRed: cotal_persona forwards capabilities for the manager to bound

mutations.name: C7 trim the inline model before its audit
mutations.expectRed: an inline model the manager recorded as sent is not reported as a dropped pin
